source: NACA Report 747 (Biermann & Hartman 1942), figure 1, digitized with tools/digitize.py from a 300 dpi scan (axis calibration residual 0.001 in r/R, 0.0005 in scale units)
propeller: Hamilton Standard 3155-6 (right hand) / 3156-6 (left hand), Clark Y sections
notes: chord and thickness from the b/D and h/b curves; twist is the median of the 30, 40 and 50 degree p/D curves converted with beta = atan(p/D / (pi r/R)) (the five curves agree within 0.1 deg where they are on the chart). h/b below r/R 0.30 is off the chart (> 0.44).
